source: Real REMAX survey; Goldman Sachs via Real Estate News

headline: Agents name the
*rate that matters*
slides.fig_caption: of agents say rates must drop below 6% to revive demand
slides.sub: A new survey of 177 agents shows optimism sliding as buyers wait.

slides.label: Agent Optimism Index, down from *54.3* a month earlier
slides.body: On a 0 to 100 scale, the latest reading slipped below the midpoint. Two in three agents say their buyers are pausing or delaying their search.

slides.title: Sellers are *starting to bend*
slides.note: Share of agents reporting each. Another 37% say rates must fall *below 5.5%* to move buyers, and if rates hold near 7%, nearly 60% expect prices to fall next year.

slides.title: Plan for a *rate-driven* 2027
slides.body: Goldman Sachs sees 3.9 million existing-home sales in 2027. Until rates move, deals will come from sellers willing to adjust, so prep listings for price talks and concessions, and keep a watch list of buyers waiting on a rate drop.
